message: Completed architectural and quality review of AI Value Studio wizard and backend. Found working core functionality but identified critical gaps in security, authentication, testing, and operational readiness for production deployment.
suggestions: Implement authentication system (JWT/OAuth2) with role-based access control
Restrict CORS origins to specific domains and add security headers
Add OpenAPI/Swagger documentation for all API endpoints
Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization
Add structured logging, health checks, and metrics collection
Create Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for containerization
Refactor frontend into smaller, reusable components with proper state management
Add comprehensive unit and integration test suite (>80% coverage)
Implement rate limiting and request/response logging
Add audit trail for wizard changes and data export/import functionality
Create CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment
Add background job processing for long-running operations
Implement file storage abstraction (local/S3) and export options (PDF/DOCX)
Add comprehensive error handling and standardized error responses
Create developer onboarding guide and operations runbook
